canon_policy: Pakistani Pashto evidence remains primary; Afghan Pashto may be cited only as an explicitly labelled regional comparator.
projection_policy: No automatic character or font conversion may be described as an Afghan Pashto edition.

variant_assessment.scripts: Use the Arabic-derived Pashto script for this edition. A Latin or romanized parallel edition would add no demonstrated curricular benefit and is not recommended.
variant_assessment.orthographies: Use Pakistan Pashto orthography consistently. Afghan orthographic forms may appear only in explicitly labelled comparative evidence, not as interchangeable target spellings.
variant_assessment.registers: Use one scholarly educational register suitable for logic and mathematics. Do not split the same locale into colloquial and academic editions.
variant_assessment.regional_editions: Maintain ps-Arab-PK as the sole current Pashto lane. A future Afghan Pashto edition should be a separately commissioned ps-Arab-AF lane with independent language evidence and QA.
variant_assessment.notation_and_numerals: Keep OpenLogic mathematical symbols, formula direction and source numerals exact in left-to-right math spans; translate surrounding prose into right-to-left Pakistani Pashto. No separate notation or numeral edition is recommended.

manager_recommendation: Include one ps-Arab-PK edition now: Pakistan Pashto orthography in Arabic-derived script, scholarly register, and the unchanged OpenLogic mathematics profile. Do not add automatic Afghan, Latin-script, colloquial, or alternate-numeral variants. If demand and native expertise support Afghan Pashto later, create an independently reviewed ps-Arab-AF edition that shares stable OLP unit IDs for comparison.
future_afghan_lane: If separately commissioned, it requires its own canon, terminology/register decisions, segment semantic QA, build QA and public-byte receipts while retaining the same stable OLP IDs for comparison.
current_effect: Confirms the existing lane method; no source ID, translation unit, published artifact or accepted build is changed.
